_legend.{date-flex}: Flexible: YYYY or YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD
_legend.{enum:a|b|c}: Closed codelist — must pick one of listed values
_legend.{open:file.csv}: Open codelist — pick from file or add custom value
_legend.{depends:X->Y}: Value constrained by another field's value

_cross_field_rules._about: Fields activate/deactivate based on other field values. Validation must check these.

rule_1_type_to_process.behavior: process enum changes based on type value. If type is absent, process is unconstrained.
rule_1_type_to_process._note: coastal_flood is NOT a hazard type — it is a PROCESS under type=flood. storm_surge is a PROCESS under type=strong_wind (not coastal_flood). Coastal flooding must be modelled as type=flood + process=coastal_flood. (14 hazard types as of the 2026-06 resync; verified against published schema docs.riskdatalibrary.org.) earthquake uses 'rupture' (singular), matching both CSV and published schema.

rule_2_type_to_imt.behavior: intensity_measure codelist switches based on type. All are open codelists (custom values allowed). Format is 'metric:unit' (e.g. AirTemp:C, PGWS:m/s, pptn24:mm).

mappings.sea_level_rise: (no imt_sea_level_rise.csv file exists — use IMT.csv universal entries)

rule_3_quantity_to_unit.behavior: unit codelist switches based on quantity_kind. All open except currency (closed, ISO 4217).

mappings.currency: unit_currency.csv (CLOSED — ISO 4217 codes only: USD, EUR, ...)

rule_4_scale_to_countries.behavior: countries requirement changes based on scale value

rule_5_analysis_to_occurrence.behavior: occurrence must contain exactly ONE of three sub-objects matching analysis_type

rule_6_entity_contact.behavior: Entity always requires name. Additionally, at least one of email or url must be present.

rule_7_risk_data_type_to_sections.behavior: Each section only makes sense when its type is in risk_data_type. Not enforced by schema but semantically expected.

mappings.exposure in risk_data_type: exposure section activates (array of exposure items)

rule_7_risk_data_type_to_sections.note: Schema does NOT enforce this — you can have a hazard section without 'hazard' in risk_data_type, but it is semantically wrong

rule_8_climate_scenario_activates_baseli.behavior: When a resource has a climate scenario (projection), baseline_period should be populated to indicate the reference period. Not schema-enforced but semantically expected.
rule_8_climate_scenario_activates_baseli.note: Historical/observational resources (no scenario) typically do not have baseline_period

taxonomy_ged4all.csv.applies_to: asset_type.id (exposure/loss/vuln) when scheme='GED4ALL' - NOT referenced by the JSON Schema

imt.csv.note: intensity_measure values; depends on hazard type (validator filters by Hazard column)

event_sets._req: REQUIRED if hazard is present (array, min 1 item)

hazards._note: Each item requires id + process (inline) AND type + intensity_measure (from HazardWithTrigger allOf chain). All four are REQUIRED.

_item.type: {enum:convective_storm|drought|earthquake|erosion|extreme_temperature|flood|landslide|pest_infestation|sea_level_rise|strong_wind|tsunami|volcanic|wildfire|dust_sand_storm}  REQUIRED  [14 types; coastal_flood is NOT here — use flood + process=coastal_flood]
_item.process: {depends:type->process_type.csv — see rule_1}  REQUIRED  [RULE 1: must match type]
_item.intensity_measure: {depends:type->imt_[type].csv}  REQUIRED  [RULE 2: codelist per type, format: metric:unit]

trigger._req: optional — for cascading hazards. Uses SimpleHazard ($ref) which requires type.
trigger.type: {enum:flood|...|dust_sand_storm — 14 types, see hazard_type.csv; NO coastal_flood}  REQUIRED if trigger present
trigger.id: {string}  REQUIRED  - local hazard identifier; REQUIRED on EVERY hazard object by the JKAN/DDH consumer (it reads hazard.id unconditionally). The JSON Schema only requires it on event_set.hazards[], so it must be added everywhere else too.

_item.event_count: 0  optional — number (use only when events array is NOT populated)

hazard._note: event.hazard requires process (inline) + type + intensity_measure (from HazardWithTrigger allOf). id is NOT a defined schema field here.
